SHOPMARKET.Settings.CoinsPerHandful.Name: Coins per Handful
SHOPMARKET.Settings.CoinsPerHandful.Hint: The Daggerheart gold track (Coins/Handfuls/Bags/Chests) has no fixed exchange rate between Coins and Handfuls in the core rules. This module needs one to do math for you — set how many Coins equal 1 Handful.

SHOPMARKET.Settings.ReturnSoldItems.Hint: When a player sells an item to a shop, add it back to that shop's stock (unless the shop entry is set to Unlimited).
SHOPMARKET.Settings.SellEnabled.Name: Allow Selling
SHOPMARKET.Settings.SellEnabled.Hint: Globally allow players to sell items back to shops.
